title: Quote of the day by Hulk Hogan: "If I have a problem with someone I talk about them. I don't…" - a lesson on respect, accountability and keeping personal conflicts where they belong
summary_full: Disagreements should remain focused on the individuals involved in the conflict.  Hulk Hogan's quote emphasizes not involving children in adult disputes.  Containing arguments to the original issue prevents unnecessary harm and wider complications.  Direct communication and taking responsibility build trust and aid resolution.  This principle applies broadly, urging focus on behavior and ideas, not personal attacks.
